pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — a close view of the bearded face under the great jewelled and pearled tiara with a crown set round it, gold rays standing out behind the head, gold lettering running across the arch above, the red mantle bordered with pearls and fastened with a huge jewelled clasp on the breast, and the blessing hand raised at the left edge, then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Valentin de Boulogne, Saint Paul Writing His Epistles — a balding bearded man in a green sleeve and a heavy red mantle bent right over a sheet laid on an open book in the one patch of light, one hand holding the page flat, a knife and folded letters stamped with red wax seals lying on the plain wooden table, and deep brown dark all round him, it had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals
pictures.name: pd_valentin_boek

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Saint John Devours the Book — the mighty angel standing in the middle of the sheet with the sun for a face and rays flooding down from it, his legs set like two pillars of fire with flame at the knee, another angel in the cloud above among the trees, John kneeling at the right with the little open book lifted to his mouth, the sea with a ship and swans at the left, and open books lying on the rocky ground at his feet, and I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, who is worthy to break the seals
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_devours_the_book

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night — the dark flame-shaped cypress standing up the left side, the night sky rolling over in a great spiral with eleven haloed stars and a crescent moon blazing yellow, the blue hills running along below, and the small sleeping village with its church spire at the lower right, and open the scroll, but no one in heaven or on earth
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, A Cavern near Naples — the mouth of a cavern seen from inside, with massive brown and grey rock arching over the whole top and down the left side, a few leaves hanging from the lip of it, and through the opening a pale rose-coloured bay with a far mountain, a small tower and a town on the shore, or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_a_cavern_near_naples

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Tears of Saint Peter — the old apostle in a yellow mantle and a blue sleeve standing against the dark rock with ivy hanging over him on both sides, his hands locked together in front of him and his wet eyes turned up to the light, and the two keys hanging at his side, and I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_tears_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Prophet Isaiah — the grey-haired prophet seated on his throne in a rose robe and a green mantle with his book shut on one finger against his knee, his head turned sharply round over his shoulder, his other hand lifted, and a curly-haired child leaning in at his back to speak to him, to open the scroll or look inside it, then one of the elders said to me
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_isaiah

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, Head of a Lion — the lion's head filling nearly the whole picture against a plain blue sky, the heavy mane brushed out in gold and brown all round it, the brow drawn down over two steady amber eyes, the muzzle greyed and marked, and the long white whiskers standing out on both sides, do not weep, behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_leeuw

pictures.scene: Giulio Clovio, David Bringing the Ark to Jerusalem — the gilded ark carried along on poles through a street of stone palaces, David in a short white and rose tunic dancing out in front of it with his arms flung wide, a bearded player drawing the bow across a viol just behind him, soldiers and women crowding in with the procession, and a boy leaning out of a balcony above to watch them pass, the Root of David has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals
pictures.name: pd_clovio_david_ark

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbaran, Agnus Dei — a young ram lying on a grey stone slab with its feet bound under it, its head laid over on its side and the eye half shut, the curled horns and the thick white fleece picked out by the light, and nothing but black behind it, then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_agnus_dei

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Lamb and the Four Living Creatures — the Lamb standing on the draped altar inside a pointed almond in the middle of the page with the cross banner beside it and seven eyes set in its head, the four winged creatures at the corners of the frame, the crowned elders seated in four blocks round the vision with harps and viols in their hands, and the Latin commentary written out below in black and red with painted initials, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders, the Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_lamb_four_living_creatures

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Pentecost — the white dove blazing at the top of the dark vault, a tongue of flame standing up over each head, the Virgin at the centre with her hands joined, and the apostles pressed close about her in red, blue, green and gold with their faces lifted and their arms thrown up, which represent the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_pentecost

pictures.scene: Cefalu Cathedral, Christ Pantocrator — the great gold mosaic Christ filling the half dome with the cross-marked halo behind His head, one hand raised in blessing at the left and the other holding the open book lettered in Greek and Latin, and below Him the Virgin standing with her hands open between two archangels in jewelled court dress, and He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne
pictures.name: pd_master_of_cefalu_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — God enthroned high in the clouds with the seven burning candlesticks set round Him and the Lamb standing up at His knee, the four winged creatures beneath the throne, the crowned elders ringed all the way round in the cloud with their crowns and their viols, one of them leading John forward on his knees in the middle of the sheet, and a wide country opening below with a town, a castle on the water and trees, when He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Angels Playing Music — one angel in a heavy flowered brocade cope bent over the keys of a pipe organ that fills the left half of the panel, a second drawing the bow across a vielle behind it, a third reaching to a gilded harp, and more crowned faces pressing in behind them under the blue sky, fell down before the Lamb, each one had a harp
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_angels_playing_music

pictures.scene: Pieter Lastman, The Sacrifice of Manoah — the angel going straight up out of the altar flame in a white robe with the smoke carrying him, Manoah kneeling in a red mantle with both hands flung open towards the fire, his wife standing behind the altar with her hands at her breast watching him go, and a great golden ewer and dish set down on the ground in front, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints
pictures.name: pd_lastman_wierook

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ with Singing Angels — Christ crowned with a jewelled tiara and haloed with gold rays at the right, holding a crystal orb and raising His hand, two angels in crowns and embroidered copes at the left singing from a great open book, and clouds under their feet against a plain gold ground, and they sang a new song, worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Diego Velazquez, Christ Crucified — the body hanging alone on the cross against a plain dark ground, the head bowed under the crown of thorns with the hair falling across one side of the face, the white loincloth knotted at the hip, blood running from the nails in the hands and from the feet down onto the wood, and the title board lettered in three tongues above, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_christ_crucified

pictures.scene: Sandro Botticelli, The Adoration of the Magi — a great train of men crowded in front of a ruined classical wall, grooms holding the bridles of white and dappled horses, a young man in blue and orange bowing low with his hand laid on his breast, old men kneeling with their hands joined, and a green country with trees and hills opening away behind them, those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation
pictures.name: pd_botticelli_the_adoration_of_the_magi

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua Passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — a pillar of white light pouring down out of the clouds over the whole picture, the gilded ark with its winged cherubim carried on poles along the bottom by priests in white robes and head cloths, armed horsemen pressing up on the right, and the tents of the camp standing away in the distance, you have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God
pictures.name: pd_west_joshua_passing_the_river_jordan_with_the_ark_of_the_covenant

pictures.scene: Giovanni di Paolo, Paradise — the blessed standing in a flowering orchard of orange trees and meeting one another and taking each other by the hands, bishops and kings and nuns and friars among them in red, blue, white and gold, a winged angel in pale gold embracing a crowned woman in red, and rabbits sitting in the grass at their feet, and they will reign upon the earth, then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels
pictures.name: pd_dipaolo_paradise

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Elders Enthroned — an angel sounding a long trumpet over the seated John at the top of the page, the elders kneeling and bowing in two groups on either side of him, Christ blessing with the open book inside a pointed mandorla in the middle, angels leaning out of blue cloud bands, and the Latin text written below in black and red with two painted initials, and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_enthroned

pictures.scene: Gustave Dore, The Heavenly Host — two small dark figures standing on a cloud at the foot of the sheet and looking up into a vast funnel of winged figures, rank behind rank of them wheeling round and round into the depth of the picture, and one blaze of light with rays running out of it at the far centre, and thousands of thousands, in a loud voice they were saying
pictures.name: pd_dore_the_heavenly_host

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing on a draped altar in the middle of a green meadow with blood running from its breast into a gold chalice, angels kneeling in a ring round the altar with censers and the cross and the pillar, the fountain of life playing into an octagonal basin below, prophets reading their books at the lower left, and the dove blazing in the sky above the far towers, worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ seated inside a deep blue almond ringed with little cherub heads, one hand raised in blessing and gold rays and red seraph wings standing out behind Him, ranks of haloed angels and saints with their hands joined crowding in on both sides against the gold ground, and one angel below holding up the cross, and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing
pictures.name: pd_angelico_lof

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Creation of the Animals — the Creator sweeping through the air in a crimson and blue mantle with His arm flung out over the water, birds streaming away from His hand into the sky, fishes swimming under the surface at the left, and deer, hares, a hedgehog and a boar pushing out across the shore in the foreground, and I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_animals

pictures.scene: Hagia Sophia, The Deesis Christ — the mosaic Christ shown down to the waist against worn gold, the long hair falling on both sides of the grave face, one hand lifted in blessing and the other holding a jewelled gospel book, and the plaster broken away all round the figure, and all that is in them, saying, to Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb
pictures.name: pd_deesis_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Adoration of the Trinity — a crowd of the blessed standing on the clouds and adoring, a pope in a tall gold cope and a bishop in a mitre at the front of them, a king in fur and a heavy gold chain beside him, men in blue and white with their hands joined and their eyes raised, and the earth and the water showing far below their feet, be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_trinity

pictures.scene: Thirteenth-century Apocalypse manuscript, The Elders Pay Homage — Christ enthroned inside a tall pointed frame in the middle of the page with the written book held open in one hand and a small gold cross in the other, angels kneeling in painted bands above Him, the crowned elders pressing in from both sides and stooping right down to lay their gold crowns on the ground in front of Him, a harp set down among them, and the Latin text in two columns below in black and red, and the four living creatures said, Amen, and the elders fell down and worshiped
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_pay_homage

lines.text: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand
of the One seated on the throne.
It had writing on both sides
and was sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice,
Who is worthy to break the seals
and open the scroll?
But no one in heaven or on earth
or under the earth was able to open the scroll
or look inside it.
And I began to weep bitterly,
because no one was found worthy
to open the scroll or look inside it.
Then one of the elders said to me,
Do not weep!
Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah,
the Root of David, has triumphed
to open the scroll and its seven seals.
Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain,
standing in the center of the throne,
encircled by the four living creatures and the elders.
The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes,
which represent the seven Spirits of God
sent out into all the earth.
And He came and took the scroll
from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
When He had taken the scroll,
the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders
fell down before the Lamb.
Each one had a harp,
and they were holding golden bowls full of incense,
which are the prayers of the saints.
And they sang a new song:
Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals,
because You were slain,
and by Your blood You purchased for God
those from every tribe and tongue
and people and nation.
You have made them to be a kingdom
and priests to serve our God,
and they will reign upon the earth.
Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels
and living creatures and elders encircling the throne,
and their number was myriads of myriads
and thousands of thousands.
In a loud voice they were saying:
Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain,
to receive power and riches
and wisdom and strength
and honor and glory and blessing!
And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth
and under the earth and in the sea,
and all that is in them, saying:
To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb
be praise and honor and glory and power
forever and ever!
And the four living creatures said, Amen,
and the elders fell down and worshiped.
